افتضخوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَخُوا (iftaḍaḵū) /if.ta.dˤa.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اُفْتُضِخُوا (uftuḍiḵū) /uf.tu.dˤi.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضِخُوا (iftaḍiḵū) /if.ta.dˤi.xuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
